name: Miami
blurb: Home base, allegedly. Ninety-six days here last year and the tan never took.

name: New York
blurb: The team onsite city. Twenty days at a time, four times a year, always a hotel with a view of a wall.

name: Boulder
blurb: Trail runs at altitude, coffee at sea-level prices. The only American city that feels like a base.

name: Montana
blurb: A Jeep Compass, a month, and more sky than a person needs.

name: Las Vegas
blurb: A layover that became five days. Nobody remembers why.

name: Joshua Tree
blurb: Bouldering by day, stars by night, an Airbnb with a hot tub and no wifi.

name: Orange County
blurb: Family. Laundry that someone else folds. The Pacific gateway.

name: Montreal
blurb: Two weeks of bagels and the discovery that French is spoken faster here.

name: La Paz
blurb: Whale sharks, a rental car, the good kind of quiet.

name: La Ventana
blurb: Kiteboarding town. Wind every afternoon, NYE on the beach, nothing to do until 2 pm.

name: Roatan
blurb: Vitalia. Five weeks on an island of biohackers and one very bad kettle.

name: Santiago
blurb: A week in the Andes' shadow before the wind country.

name: Patagonia
blurb: Edge City. A month at the end of the world with a hundred other people who also work on the internet.

name: Buenos Aires
blurb: DevConnect. Steak at midnight, meetings at ten, a city that never asked what time zone you were on.

name: Iguazu
blurb: Waterfalls that make Niagara look like a tap.

name: Lisbon
blurb: The European base. Hills, tiles, the Airbnb that cancelled on the day.

name: Carvoeiro
blurb: Cliffs, caves, a rental car with the turning radius of a boat.

name: Madrid
blurb: A week of late dinners and early meetings. The math does not work.

name: Granada
blurb: Free tapas with every drink. The Alhambra. The Sierra Nevada right there.

name: London
blurb: Six weeks of a city that charges rent on the air.

name: Brussels
blurb: A week. Fries as a food group.

name: Amsterdam
blurb: Bikes have right of way over everything, including you.

name: Marseille
blurb: One night. The bouillabaisse was worth the night.

name: Hyeres
blurb: Twenty-six days on the Riviera. Bread is the answer. The mosquitoes had questions.

name: Antibes
blurb: Nice, Monaco, the sea every morning. If you can't beat 'em.

name: Edinburgh
blurb: A night between the Highlands and Morocco. Rain both ways.

name: Scottish Highlands
blurb: Aviemore, Skye, Glencoe. Six weeks, twelve dry hours, the best of them all.

name: Iceland
blurb: A campervan, the ring road, sleep that never gets dark.

name: Munich
blurb: Oktoberfest in September. Nothing about this city makes sense and all of it is on time.

name: Innsbruck
blurb: The Nordkette out the window. Via ferrata on Saturdays, the climbing gym on Tuesdays. The best month of the year.

name: Salzkammergut
blurb: Bad Goisern, Gosau, lakes you can drink from. Cut from a month to a week and still worth it.

name: Casablanca
blurb: A week of tagine and the realization that the movie was not filmed here.

name: Dakhla
blurb: Three weeks on a lagoon in the Sahara. Wind at 2 pm like a train timetable. The French have watches.

name: Nairobi
blurb: The October gap. Altitude you do not notice until the run.

name: Seoul
blurb: A week of food that is both spicy and a personality.

name: Chiang Mai
blurb: Nomad capital, cafés per capita off the charts, khao soi for breakfast.

name: Bangkok
blurb: Street food at 1 am, a tuk-tuk at 1:05, regret at 4.

name: Hong Kong
blurb: Skyscrapers with hiking trails behind them. A week of dim sum and stairs.

name: Tokyo
blurb: Three weeks. An animal café. An otter. A hospital. In that order.

name: Minakami
blurb: Nikko and Minakami: onsens, snow, a train that apologizes for being early.

name: Kathmandu
blurb: Permits, a duffel, the last real shower for two weeks.

name: Manaslu Circuit
blurb: Fourteen days on foot around the eighth-highest mountain in the world. Dal bhat power, twenty-four hour.
